name: Empire Tuscarora Lateral
researcher_notes: This is a real, separate project with no row of its own. The Federal Register notice of 10 April 2014 for Federal Energy Regulatory Commission docket CP14-112 says Empire Pipeline and National Fuel Gas Supply filed on 18 March 2014 to build about 17 miles of new 12 and 16 inch pipeline, with an interconnection to the National Fuel system, in Steuben County, New York and Tioga County, Pennsylvania. It gives a cost of about 43.7 million dollars. The Energy Information Administration August 2026 release lists it as Tuscarora Lateral Project, a completed lateral, operator Empire Pipeline, in service 4 November 2015, 17 miles, 54 million cubic feet per day added, 12 and 16 inch (Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 808). It is not the Tuscarora Gas Pipeline (P0275), which is an unrelated Oregon to Nevada line. The existing Empire rows (P0288 main line, P2531 North Expansion, P2575 and P6008 Northern Access) are different projects. 17 miles is about 27 km, above the 25 km floor, and it is new pipe. Proposed row shape follows the expansion convention: parent name Empire Pipeline, segment Tuscarora Lateral Project. Owner and parent follow the spelling on the existing Empire rows. Confidence is medium: the two sources are one chain (the EIA entry comes from the same FERC docket), the FERC order and in-service notice were not opened, and the exact start and end points were not found, so endpoint and state fields are left blank. The 54 million cubic feet per day figure is incremental capacity from the EIA release only. Not done: route research. Route type would be unavailable until FERC alignment sheets or the environmental assessment maps are digitized; the environmental assessment notice is in the Federal Register of 6 November 2014 (document 2014-26390).
